## v1.9.3 — Clock timezone/format + custom search engines

Configurable dashboard clock timezone/format and custom web search engines ([#17](https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/issues/17)).

### Added

- **Clock timezone & format** — IANA timezone picker and 12h/24h preference in Settings → Appearance; the live dashboard clock follows them
- **Custom search engines** — Add HTTPS search URL templates (`{query}` or `%s`) alongside built-ins and choose a default engine

### Upgrade

```bash
./update-amud.sh
```

Or pull the latest Docker image: `tradmss/amud-dashboard:latest`

Hard-refresh your browser (Ctrl+Shift+R) after updating if you use the PWA.

**Recommended:** `v1.9.3`

**Binaries:** `amud-server`, `amud-agent` (amd64 + arm64), `ui.tar.gz`, and `SHA256SUMS` are attached below.
